title: Grateful Dead Live at Veterans Auditorium on 1969-06-28
lineage: SBD > Master Reel > Cassette > DAT > DAT > ZA2 > Soundforge > .wav > mkwACT > SHN

ai_review.summary: High‑energy June 28, 1969 show with standout pedal‑steel Doin' That Rag and crisp soundboard capture despite minor hiss.
ai_review.review: The recording is a solid soundboard source that remains clear and listenable, though a faint background hiss and occasional brightness/dullness quirks are noted. Musically the band delivers an energetic performance marked by Jerry Garcia’s pedal‑steel on “Doin' That Rag”, superb renditions of “High Time”, “Lovelight” and classic country‑folk numbers, showcasing the group’s transition toward a folk/country sound.

ai_rating.rationale: Nearly all reviewers give 5‑star ratings, praising both performance and recording; only minor technical complaints keep the rating just below perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and balanced with good instrument separation. Reviewers mention a faint background hiss, occasional over‑bright or dull tonal balance (possible Dolby B artifact), but overall the recording is very listenable.

standout_songs: Sitting on Top of the World
show_quality.setlist_flow: A transitional set blending early Workingman's Dead folk/country material with blues and ballads, flowing smoothly from pedal‑steel country numbers to tighter rock jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his pedal‑steel work on “Doin' That Rag” and ripping guitar licks on “Sitting on Top of the World” and other ballads.
